neighbours.label: tokens of eighteenth- and nineteenth-century historical narrative, chiefly the last digit of an 18xx year used as a date and Victorian-era names, as against twentieth-century dates and non-date numbers
fire: The railway reached the small valley town in 1852 after years of delay.
Her grandfather sailed from Liverpool to New York in 1867.
A cholera outbreak swept through the city in 1849.
The first public library in the county opened in 1878.
Prime Minister Gladstone spoke in the Commons that evening.
The treaty was finally signed by both nations in 1815.
Gold was discovered in the nearby hills in 1859.
Abolitionists gathered in Boston throughout the 1830s.
quiet: The railway reached the small valley town in 1952 after years of delay.
Her grandfather sailed from Liverpool to New York in 1967.
A flu outbreak swept through the city in 2009.
The first public library in the county opened in 1978.
The Prime Minister spoke in the Commons that evening.
The parcel was delivered to unit 1815 on the industrial estate.
The team scored 1859 points over the whole season.
Protesters gathered in Boston throughout the 1960s.
